title: Replace Future.delayed wall-clock waits with deterministic signals in notification cold-start tests (TQ-6)
why: These bare-ProviderContainer tests (no WidgetTester/FakeAsync virtualization) use a real-wall-clock Future.delayed(100ms/200ms) to 'give async load time to complete' instead of awaiting a concrete signal. This encodes an unstated assumption about how fast SharedPreferences-mock plus microtasks resolve rather than an explicit dependency, and is non-hermetic under CI scheduler contention.
recommendation: Replace with pumpEventQueue() (package:test) or listen-and-await-first-matching-value instead of fixed sleeps.
acceptance_criteria: None of the 4 listed files contain Future.delayed combined with a millisecond Duration literal.
